display_name: Citations in regulations under the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5755-1995, recorded as typed values with their tests: six citations of the schedule lettered ב (defects) and two sound controls (part one); five references to the local professional committee or section 232 in the long-term care regulations (defects) and one control (part two); not an encoding of the Law or of the regulations
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: for part one, a widow who has remarried and whose husband's income is tested against a twelfth of the amount in item 1 of Schedule B (regulation 2 of the survivors-pension regulations); for part two, a person entitled to a nursing benefit who asks to receive it in cash (regulation 1(א) of the care regulations). The row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

source.note: the seven regulation texts are unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidations; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in registers/source-bundle/official/ and registers/source-bundle/amending-laws/ with their page images; official/SOURCES.json and aids/SOURCES.json give URL, retrieval date, sha256 and size of each file; the Kovetz HaTakanot files come from olaw.org.il, an unofficial archive of the Reshumot issues. Every PDF in official/ is a page extract of only the pages read; Sefer HaChukim 2511 is deposited as three cropped strips of page images, with no PDF page; the whole files are not in the bundle and official/SOURCES.json keeps their URL, sha256 and size.

expected_red.note: six citations of לוח ב׳ in regulations made between 1971 and 1979 point at the Treasury allocation schedule (SH 1522 p. 299), repealed from 1 January 2016 (SH 2511 pp. 248, 249); for each, the citation-points-at-what-it-says assertion and the stands-on-10-November-2026 assertion fail, and one more states that item 3 exists in a schedule that has items 1 and 2 only
